name: Foaster
long_description:
Foaster is building the AI-native McKinsey, starting with AI transformation.

We deploy AI agents that interview a company's employees at scale, map how work actually gets done, identify bottlenecks and AI opportunities, and draft a transformation roadmap in just 2 weeks. Expert consultants review the final outputs, add judgment where it matters, and feed their corrections back into the system.

We believe current AI models already have the capabilities required to automate most of the work consultants do. But traditional consulting firms use them to improve the old model: helping consultants work faster. 

Foaster is instead rebuilding a new model from scratch, where agents do the work that needs scale and humans review the final outputs, bring expertise, and improve the system overtime.

We are starting with AI transformation, then progressively expanding to more and more consulting projects using the same approach. Every mission creates structured knowledge from interviews, workflow maps, recommendations, and expert corrections, so the system gets better with every client engagement.

The $500B consulting market will eventually be run by our AI agents and a small number of expert humans.

founders.founder_bio:
Raphaël is the co-founder and CEO of Foaster.

At 11, he grew a tennis fan community to 400,000+ people. At 18, he joined Rafael Nadal's team as an agent. He later became a TEDx speaker at 23 and built a public audience around consulting, writing essays that accumulated hundreds of thousands of views.

Before Foaster, Raphaël and his co-founder Alexandre ran their own AI consultancy. They recently co-authored two of 2025's most viral LLM benchmarks, reaching 12M+ views.

launches.title: Foaster - AI agents that drive your AI transformation
launches.tagline: The AI-native consulting firm for AI transformation.
launches.body:
Hey 👋 We’re Raphaël and Alexandre, co-founders of [Foaster](https://foaster.ai).

# 

# **TL;DR**

Our agents run **AI-led interviews** **across your entire company** to map how work actually happens, identify the **highest-impact AI opportunities** in just a few days, and support execution through **adoption tracking, personalized upskilling, and expert guidance.**

Book a demo [here](https://foaster.cal.com/raphael.dabadie/30min).

# 

# **❌ The Problem**

Most companies confuse AI adoption with AI transformation.

**AI adoption** is giving employees better tools: ChatGPT, Copilot, Claude, internal assistants.

That can make individuals faster. But the company itself often stays the same: same workflows, same meetings, same approval chains, same bottlenecks.

**AI transformation** is different. It means redesigning how work happens around what AI now makes possible.

The problem is that this transformation is broad, fast-moving, and continuous. It touches **every function, every workflow, and every role**, while tools and capabilities keep evolving.

**Traditional methods cannot keep up.** Workshops, consulting projects, and static roadmaps are too slow, too generic, and too disconnected from day-to-day operations.

# **✅ The Solution**

Foaster combines AI agents and human experts to help companies make AI transformation scalable, continuous, and personalized.

### 1. Mapping the company

We run **30 to 45-minute AI-led interviews** across the organization.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=100799&key=user_uploads/3198551/2ee984d6-7f59-4b8a-9541-fc5ee33eaaef)

Agents collect **the context that usually stays trapped in people’s heads**: workflows, tools, handoffs, bottlenecks, dependencies, informal habits, and repetitive tasks.

The result is **a granular map of how the company actually works**.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=100799&key=user_uploads/3198551/5f0f7cd9-27f6-4558-b8b2-4e193bd13569)

### 2. Turning the map into a roadmap

Agents reason over that map to **identify where AI can have the highest impact**: what should be automated, redesigned, augmented, or improved first.

Our **human experts review the findings**, bring business judgment, and help leadership prioritize the roadmap based on impact, feasibility, and company goals.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=100799&key=user_uploads/3198551/b404941d-2f4f-41e6-a966-bfb809830afc)

### 3. Keeping the transformation alive

Foaster keeps the map updated over time, tracks adoption, detects where teams are stuck, and generates **personalized upskilling for each employee** based on their role, tools, workflows, and level.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=100799&key=user_uploads/3198551/9791493a-e960-496a-b416-0593848b3691)

Agents handle the scale, follow-up, and personalization while human experts bring judgment, expertise, change management, and implementation support when needed.

The goal: **help the whole company move in one direction while supporting every employee at individual scale.**

# [**👬**](https://emojipedia.org/men-holding-hands) **The Team**

We spent the past year working as AI consultants and saw firsthand how broken the old model was.

We also did AI research and built two benchmarks that got widely shared: [The Werewolf Benchmark](https://werewolf.foaster.ai), notably shared by Greg Brockman, Clément Delangue, and Thomas Wolf, and [The Political Gap Between AIs and Citizens](https://llm-politics.foaster.ai), shared by Elon Musk and viewed over 12 million times on social media.

At the same time, we watched models get really good at knowledge work. It became obvious that AI could do a large part of what AI consultants were doing, but at much faster speed and scale.

## **📣 Our Ask**

We’d love intros to enterprises or mid-market companies trying to figure out what AI transformation should look like in practice.

If you know someone leading AI transformation, AI enablement, operations, or process improvement, we’d love to talk.

👉 [**raphael.dabadie@foaster.ai**](mailto:raphael.dabadie@foaster.ai)
